client_brief:
Kilnmore: house photography

Project overview
Kilnmore is the repeat client for this benchmark series. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Kilnmore house photography, range and glaze surfaces, Kilnmore marketplace primaries and store page tiles, and Kilnmore delivery-size crop matrix.

What we will provide
kilnmore_range_captures/ (14 frames, 6000 x 4000); kilnmore_glaze_macros/ (8 frames); kilnmore_tissue_wrap.jpg; kilnmore_range.csv; kilnmore_notes.txt. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Additional archive files
kilnmore_shelf_card.pdf. These files are supplied for provenance only because their former deliverable class is outside this commission. Do not silently turn them into extra scope.

Scope and deliverables
- Kilnmore house photography, range and glaze surfaces: Fourteen range masters brought across two sessions to one house target (one white point, one black point, one height in frame) with every glaze reading as the glaze the copy names, plus a separately targeted family of glaze surface close ups, one per glaze...
- Kilnmore marketplace primaries and store page tiles: Fourteen square marketplace primaries at intake size on a plain ground with nothing else in the frame, piece optically centred with clear air at every edge, plus fourteen genuinely transparent variants placed on the studio's warm grey for the store pages,...
- Kilnmore delivery-size crop matrix: A client-facing matrix showing each approved master at its actual placement ratios and sizes, with source dimensions, crop decisions, rejected frames, and no-upscale checks. 

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$4,000-$8,500 fixed; target delivery 4 to 6 weeks; direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork 'Graphic designer, advertising creatives' open call quoted in the ledger, in which a direct to consumer homeware brand asks for high performing static creatives, promotional graphics and multiple creative variations for testing, worked from existing brand guidelines, with clean, modern, conversion focused visuals and an ongoing collaboration. The real post names no client and attaches no images, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional matte-ceramic homeware label Kilnmore, and no real marketplace, network, ad product or trademark appears anywhere. Co-anchor one: the Freelancer.com post in which a small shop wanted a product photographer for ten to fifteen catalog shots plus a logo. Neither literal ask is connector work (it cannot operate a camera and it cannot draw a mark from nothing), so the commission is honestly re-cast as the post-production half a product photographer actually does at the desk: the client sends its own captures and a photographed printed mark, and the freelancer returns a matched set plus a recovered, placeable mark. Co-anchor two: the Freelancer.com brief from a vendor that already had product descriptions and a clean image set and needed the specification bearing retail material an intake team approves. The ledger's own repositioning note applies: a multi product grid catalogue is not producible, because a merge emits one record per page, so that anchor lands here as the per piece shelf card the stockists stand beside the work, built from the flat press card the studio's printer already prints.

The ledger's own repositioning note applies: a multi product grid catalogue is not producible, because a merge emits one record per page, so that anchor lands here as the per piece shelf card the stockists stand beside the work, built from the flat press card the studio's printer already prints.
price_band_and_audience: Considered handmade stoneware at thirty eight to ninety five dollars per piece, buyer thirty to fifty five, buying craft and buying a specific glaze. The band is load-bearing in an unusually literal way: at this price the glaze IS the product, so colour fidelity outranks punch, and the correct treatment is a quiet, neutral, slightly cool-to-warm-honest house look with generous air, one white point across the range, and no saturation lift that would make a celadon read greener than the piece in the buyer's hand. The same fourteen pieces at a six dollar mass-import band would correctly be graded punchy, warm and saturated and cropped tight to fill the tile, because there the picture is selling a category rather than a specific glaze, and a wrong hue is nobody's problem. Ship that treatment here and every returns email the studio already gets doubles. Push the other way into near-black grounds, deep shadow and styling props and it becomes a two hundred dollar gallery ceramics house, which misprices a thirty eight dollar mug and also breaks the marketplace's plain ground rule outright. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even with every technical gate green. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_range_captures/ (14 frames, 6000 x 4000)
assets_supplied.kind: Studio product photography of the fourteen autumn pieces, shot in the studio corner on a pale sweep across two sessions either side of a firing.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All fourteen, same corner, same sweep, two sessions. Session two was after the November firing."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Four pieces are the bone and oatmeal glazes, whose glazed shoulder and rim sit within a hair of the pale sweep in value, so the one-call knockout hands back a cutout that looks complete and clean at preview scale while having quietly bitten the rim, and the bite is invisible against a plain near-white ground and obvious against the studio's own warm grey. Separately the second session's celadon sits far enough off the first session's that no single whole-frame move carries it across without taking the sweep muddy.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_glaze_macros/ (8 frames)
assets_supplied.kind: Close ups of the glazed surface itself: crazing, a rim break, a slip trail, a pooled foot.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The surface shots for the product pages. Shot on the bench, not the sweep."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two of the eight are the same glaze photographed twice under different light and one glaze in the range has no close up at all, which no filename and no column reveals. They also sit on the raw bench rather than the sweep, so the house target that suits the range frames takes the bench distinctly green when applied whole-frame.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_tissue_wrap.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of a sheet of the studio's printed wrapping tissue lying on a table, the mark printed in one ink as a repeating pattern across the whole sheet, a small-caps wordmark beside an enclosed kiln-arch device.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only clean copy of our mark left. It is printed on the tissue we wrap everything in."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Because the mark repeats across the sheet, a selection that correctly takes the ink takes every repeat, and the returned bounding box is therefore the extent of the whole sheet rather than of one mark, so a bounds crop driven by it yields the tissue and a trace of it yields a field of tiny marks that looks plausible at thumbnail size. The tissue is also crinkled, so the ink runs light along the folds, and the arch device is an enclosed form that background removal returns as a solid shape.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_shelf_card.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The flat press PDF of the shelf card the studio's printer already prints, a trim size card with a glaze colour band across the head, four copy lines below it and a square block where the glaze picture sits.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "This is the card our printer runs. We just need one per piece with the right words on it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: What the card looks like on paper says nothing about what it becomes as editable structure: the four copy lines may convert as one continuous flow rather than four addressable blocks, and the mapping readout of that flow can omit an entire run while keeping its line break, so every offset past the omission is short and the validator still calls the mapping valid.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_range.csv
assets_supplied.kind: One row per piece: name, glaze, form, dimensions, capacity, firing note, care line, consignment price.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The range as we list it. The care line is what the shops are legally happy with, so it cannot be reworded."

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_notes.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text: the studio's warm grey house ground, the marketplace intake rules as the studio received them, and the three rejection reasons the marketplace returned.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Their rules as they sent them, and the three times they bounced us."

Every glaze in the range has its own surface close up and no close up stands in for two glazes.

The note states, per photograph, what was applied and why that frame differs from its neighbours, plus the glaze-to-close-up reconciliation, every resize any tool reported, and the places where the studio's own pages and the marketplace intake rules cannot both be satisfied.

Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the knockout actually held on the pale pieces, which cannot be judged on the ground it was first judged against. Four of the fourteen are the bone and oatmeal glazes whose shoulder and rim run within a hair of the pale sweep in value, and on those frames the one-call knockout returns a cutout that is clean, complete and entirely convincing at preview scale while having taken a bite out of the rim. Against the marketplace's plain near-white ground the bite is invisible, because what was removed and what replaced it are both near white, so the primary tile passes inspection. The same cutout on the studio's warm grey shows the piece with a chewed shoulder. Nothing in any response distinguishes the four frames from the ten.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering dodges it, because the defect is a property of this glaze against this sweep and it is only legible on the second ground, which is a deliverable rather than a diagnostic. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says both grounds must exist and that both have to be the same photograph underneath, which is the client's requirement, not a disclosure that one ground hides what the other reveals. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a different chain for those frames, selecting the sweep as a material, inverting it, and filling, rather than asking for a subject.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-judge every cutout on the warm grey rather than on the plain ground, re-derive the affected pieces through a material-named sweep selection inverted and filled, and re-cut both the primary and the store tile from the new master so the two grounds do not drift apart.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Fourteen marketplace primaries that pass intake and fourteen store tiles showing bitten rims on exactly the four glazes the studio's quietest, most expensive pieces are, on a line whose returns problem is already about colour and truthfulness.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the selection on the tissue actually spans. The mark is printed as a repeat across the whole sheet, so a correctly worded ink level prompt takes the ink faithfully and takes every repeat of it, and the returned bounding box is the extent of that mask, which is the sheet. Driving a bounds crop from it therefore succeeds and yields the tissue; tracing that yields a field of dozens of tiny marks with a viewBox that can be injected and a background path that can be stripped, all of it looking like a legitimate result at thumbnail size and unusable as a placeable mark. Nothing reports that the extent covers many instances rather than one, because a mask extent has no notion of instances.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Doing it right the first time presumes knowing that the returned geometry is an extent rather than an object, and that this particular sheet repeats, which is a fact about the client's wrapping paper. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says only that the mark is printed on the tissue they wrap orders in. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix inverts the order of operations, cutting a single repeat out of the raw photograph by eye first and only then selecting, inverting, tracing and cleaning, which is a different chain rather than the same chain again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Crop one repeat out of the source photograph before any selection is made, choosing a repeat that falls on flat tissue rather than across a crinkle where the ink runs light, then re-run selection, polarity, bounds, trace, viewBox and ground path removal on that crop, and re-judge the arch device at the size it actually reproduces.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A brand mark delivered as a sheet of marks, which reduces to a grey texture the moment it is placed at corner size on a store page, on a studio whose only surviving copy of its identity was this photograph.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's card actually is as editable structure, and then whether the mapping built against that structure landed. Two things arrive only by running. First, granularity is not under anyone's control: the four copy lines that read as four blocks on paper can convert as one continuous flow, and the square where the glaze picture sits may or may not survive as a frame anything can bind to, so the shape of the card as a merge is discovered rather than planned. Second, the readout of that flow can omit an entire run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid, the template preparation reports success, and two fields simply never appear on the merged card.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, because conversion granularity is a property of the supplied PDF and the readout's omission is invisible in the readout itself. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says only that the printer already runs this card and that one is needed per piece. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is to reconstruct the document's true text from the document rather than from the readout, recompute every offset against that, and re-verify placeholders by inspecting the prepared template, which is a different method rather than a repeat.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild the mapping from the document's own reconstructed story text, re-prepare the template, confirm each placeholder by inspecting the result rather than reading the success line, re-merge and re-render the run, and if the picture block turns out not to be bindable, tell the studio and move the glaze picture to a collateral that can carry it.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Fourteen shelf cards printed and distributed to six shops with the care line and one specification field silently blank on every one of them, having passed a validity check, a success message and a page count.

decision_gates: Where to put the house target, given that the honest target for a glaze led range is fidelity to the piece in the hand rather than the most attractive celadon.
Whether the fourteen frames are one shoot. The studio believes they nearly are; the row is the only place that can be settled.
How far to push a second session frame before it stops being worth saving, versus naming it in the note.
Knockout route per piece: the one-call route for the dark coherent glazes versus a material-named sweep selection inverted and filled for the pale ones whose rim has no contrast against the sweep.

Selection prompt wording on the tissue: naming the sheet takes the sheet, naming the ink's own visual properties takes the mark, and background removal on an enclosed arch is the wrong instrument entirely.
Whether the returned geometry from a selection describes one thing or many, and therefore whether cropping comes before selecting or after.
Whether to trust a confident crop on a near-uniform glaze surface or to spend the extra calls on an explicit selection.
What the supplied press card can structurally carry, and what to tell the studio about the fields it cannot.

Every marketplace primary sits on a plain ground with nothing else in the frame: no prop, no mark, no words, no invented shadow, square, at or above their minimum size.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of pottery. IDENTITY: these are this studio's actual fourteen pieces in their actual glazes, and the entire commission exists because the pictures are not currently true to the glazes, so a regenerated piece is not a fix but the disease. The mark must be RECOVERED off a photograph of the studio's own printed tissue, because a regenerated mark is another company's logo. SPEC: the marketplace intake demands a plain ground with nothing else in frame, square, above a minimum size, with no interpolated pixels, and the studio's own pages demand the opposite ground from the same underlying photograph, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for. RECORDS: fourteen shelf cards, one page per piece, each carrying that piece's own uneditable care line, is a data run and not a picture. EDITABILITY: the season post is defined by being editable, because pieces sell out and the studio cannot re-commission. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this cutout hold on the other ground, does this selection describe one mark or forty, did this field actually land on the card.

proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.

Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.

residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.
